subject: Does ggplot2 have a function similar to the bar() function in matlab?

messages.author: 20b73f4748706290
messages.subject: Does ggplot2 have a function similar to the bar() function in matlab?
parts:
Hello,

The bar(x,y) function in matlab draws a bar for each element in y at
locations specified in x, where x is a vector defining the x-axis
intervals for the vertical bars. y is pretty much the height of the
bar. I would like to know how to draw such a graph using ggplot2.
Thank you

messages.author: 92a06be4d96a96ee
messages.subject: Re: Does ggplot2 have a function similar to the bar() function in matlab?
parts:
ggplot surely does!  geom_bar(..., stat='identity')

df <- data.frame(x = letters[1:10], y = 1:10)
ggplot() + geom_bar(data=df, aes(x=x, y=y), stat='identity')


Justin
